sources.title: Gork (parody) — Grokipedia
sources.snippet: Gork (parody) Gork is a human-operated parody account (@gork) on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter), launched on April 30, 2025, that satirizes xAI's Grok AI chatbot by posting exaggerated, humorous, and slang-heavy replies mimicking Grok's conversational style without any official affiliation.
